### 📌 Mod Info
Mod changes Fizz's fish bait and shark (R) into **Lagocephalus sceleratus**.

***Lagocephalus sceleratus** - gotronus (Gmelin, 1789), commonly known as the silver-cheeked toadfish, or Sennin-fugu, or Gotronu (Japanese: 仙人河豚), is an extremely poisonous marine bony fish in the family Tetraodontidae (puffer fishes).*
